hook: An 8-year-old needed off a cruise ship, 20 miles out at sea.
narration: This rescue swimmer was lowered onto a cruise ship, twenty miles off the California coast.
An eight-year-old boy aboard the Royal Princess had to get to a hospital.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew found the ship west of Eureka, above a layer of fog.
Rails, masts and antennas can snag a hoist cable, so the hoist operator guides the pilot with short calls, because the pilot cannot see below.
Then the rescue basket went down to the deck.
[short pause] The crew hoisted the boy and his family up into the helicopter.
outcome: They flew him to emergency medical services at Saint Joseph Hospital in Eureka.
title: Hoisting a boy off a cruise ship at sea
question_comment: Have you ever needed help while out at sea on a cruise?

description:
A Coast Guard helicopter aircrew hoisted an 8-year-old boy and his family off the cruise ship Royal Princess about 20 miles west of Eureka, California, on Sept. 24, 2024, and transferred him to emergency medical services.
